notes.summary: Updates the egui adapter to egui 0.37 and fixes rendering error handling.
changed: The egui feature now uses egui 0.37. Applications using egui types must update to the same version; use the adapter's egui re-export to keep versions aligned.
The minimum supported Rust version is now 1.95. Bundled egui fonts remain enabled.
fixed: Reject surfaces larger than 65535 pixels per side and textures larger than 65536 texels per side instead of drawing or sampling incorrectly.
After failed egui texture uploads, redraw the next frame and release textures even when a frame fails.
Reject egui meshes with invalid indices or incomplete triangles.
Keep daily Clippy checks compatible with newer Rust while retaining the minimum supported compiler.
